query:
UPDATE cars c
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    c2.id as car_id,
    MIN(ev.id) as ev_id
  FROM cars c2
  JOIN evVehicles ev 
    ON LOWER(TRIM(c2.make)) = LOWER(TRIM(ev.make))
    AND LOWER(TRIM(c2.model)) = LOWER(TRIM(ev.model))
  WHERE c2.evdbVehicleId IS NULL
  GROUP BY c2.id
) matched ON c.id = matched.car_id
SET c.evdbVehicleId = matched.ev_id;
